submissions.decision-bound-late-course-tickets: SELECT wave_code, COUNT(*) AS observed_tickets, SUM(handoff_first - accept_last > allowance) AS min_late, SUM(handoff_last - accept_first > allowance) AS max_late FROM ticket_window WHERE handoff_last IS NOT NULL GROUP BY wave_code ORDER BY wave_code ASC
submissions.decision-bound-missing-fold-offsets: WITH bounds AS (SELECT batch_code, MAX(band_lo - raw_x) AS lo, MIN(band_hi - raw_x) AS hi FROM fold_strip GROUP BY batch_code) SELECT batch_code, CASE WHEN lo > hi THEN 'conflict' WHEN lo = hi THEN 'resolved' ELSE 'open' END AS finding, CASE WHEN lo = hi THEN lo END AS offset_px FROM bounds ORDER BY batch_code ASC
submissions.decision-bound-preview-fix-by-consecutiv: WITH boundaries AS (SELECT b.profile_code, v.build_no AS fixed_build, b.slip_id AS blank_slip, v.slip_id AS visible_slip, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.profile_code ORDER BY v.build_no DESC) AS rn FROM bench_slip AS b JOIN bench_slip AS v ON v.profile_code = b.profile_code AND v.build_no = b.build_no + 1 WHERE b.preview_state = 'blank' AND v.preview_state = 'visible') SELECT profile_code, fixed_build, blank_slip, visible_slip FROM boundaries WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY profile_code COLLATE BINARY ASC
submissions.decision-bound-reset-time-from-signed-si: WITH old_slips AS (SELECT meter_code, seen_min, slip_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY meter_code ORDER BY seen_min DESC, slip_id COLLATE BINARY ASC) AS rn FROM field_slip WHERE signed_flag = 1 AND lamp_code = 'OLD'), new_slips AS (SELECT meter_code, seen_min, slip_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY meter_code ORDER BY seen_min ASC, slip_id COLLATE BINARY ASC) AS rn FROM field_slip WHERE signed_flag = 1 AND lamp_code = 'NEW') SELECT o.meter_code, o.seen_min AS after_min, n.seen_min AS by_min, o.slip_id AS old_source, n.slip_id AS new_source FROM old_slips AS o JOIN new_slips AS n ON n.meter_code = o.meter_code WHERE o.rn = 1 AND n.rn = 1 ORDER BY o.meter_code ASC
